reason: We have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years without paying for software, and changing our established routine for an unfamiliar platform isn't worth the friction. If I test it at all, I'll just stay on the free tier rather than paying ₹12,990 upfront.
objection: Our spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups have worked for ten years for free; why should I disrupt our routine and pay ₹12,990 when article clerks still have to manually forward files?
would_change_my_mind: Direct native WhatsApp integration so neither clients nor staff have to adopt a new tool, plus completely automating my Saturday GST reconciliation.
